cases.source_claim: Load average is a CPU run-queue average, uses logarithmic smoothing, and four CPUs with one active task each give raw load one.
cases.finding: 原始Linux负载不按CPU数归一化；统计可运行与不可中断任务，采用指数平滑。四个持续活跃任务的稳态原始负载约四，而不是因有四CPU就变成一。
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 先澄清平均负载：它不是 CPU 使用率，也不是自动除以 CPU 数后的指标；Linux 还把不可中断任务计入其中。原讲这里的四 CPU 举例，混用了原始值和归一化值。
cases.production_action: Keep source statement attributable; add explicit AI clarification before using this as a diagnostic rule.

cases.source_claim: cgroups is a resource-control technology built into systemd.
cases.finding: cgroups是内核资源控制机制；systemd组织并配置其层级与控制器，不是内核功能的归属者。
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 这里的 cgroups 来自 Linux 内核；systemd 是利用它来组织、管理服务资源。两者不是一回事。
cases.production_action: Retain original attribution in quoted draft; correction must be clearly non-speaker commentary.

cases.source_claim: dnf is system.slice while ls is user.slice; resource rules prevent mutual interference, and desktops automatically boost nice values.
cases.finding: 分组由启动路径和服务配置决定，不由命令名字固定决定。权重或配额不保证完全隔离；桌面交互改善也不能普遍等同于自动修改nice。
cases.video_observation: The dd tasks are visibly under google-startup-scripts.service; the cgtop table separately shows system.slice. Frames do not establish every ls/dnf task's membership or actual controller settings.
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 演示中的分组和限制，是这台机器的具体配置。排障时，要查实际进程属于哪个控制组，不能只凭它叫 ls 还是 dnf 来判断；桌面响应策略也因系统而异。
cases.production_action: Do not generalize the demo's explanation to all systems or claim measured causal controller proof.

cases.source_claim: The first vmstat row is an accumulated total and later rows are differences from that baseline.
cases.finding: vmstat首行的活动速率通常是开机以来平均，内存/进程栏是即时状态；后续活动速率对应采样区间。bi/bo不是比特数，具体单位按版本手册，不擅加固定块大小。
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 读 vmstat 时，要分清即时状态和区间速率。首行的活动统计通常以开机以来为范围，后续才是每个采样区间；不要把它们都当成累计总量。
cases.production_action: Keep the source's 5-second/10-report demo; do not silently rewrite it into a different invocation or measurement.

cases.source_claim: Modern NFS universally honors Ctrl+C; uninterruptible tasks can simply be killed and are periodically scheduled to poll I/O.
cases.finding: 不能保证Ctrl+C能解除所有NFS等待；旧intr选项在较新内核被忽略。D状态、唤醒和信号响应依具体等待点而异，不等于周期性上CPU轮询，更不是kill命令必定立即生效。
cases.reference_limit: Generic wait_event sleeps until a condition/wakeup and has separate timeout variants; this is not evidence of the replay's exact NFS wait site or kernel. NFS manual establishes the signal-option limitation.
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 这里展示的是这个 NFS 场景的现象，不能推成所有 D 状态都能用 Ctrl+C 或 kill 立即解除。不要在生产系统上照抄批量结束进程的演示；先核实等待原因。
cases.production_action: Do not execute source kill commands, write /proc, or imply that this review changed a real service.

cases.source_claim: PCI MSI-X labels identify shared devices, and interrupt counts proxy network data volume.
cases.finding: 中断合并与NAPI轮询使中断次数不等于包数或字节数；高计数也不独立证明带宽打满。仅凭PCI MSI-X字样不能确定设备共享或网卡身份。
cases.video_observation: Labels and raw counts are visible, including virtio device names. No PCI-to-interface mapping or packet/byte-rate proof is present in these frames.
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 中断计数只能作线索，不能直接换算成流量。设备识别和网络瓶颈，还要结合实际接口统计、驱动和设备映射。
cases.production_action: Preserve the speaker's 'probably' and 'might'; do not turn a device guess into a confirmed identity.

cases.source_claim: PRI and nice are interchangeable, nice runs to +20, and priority16 jobs always preempt priority20 jobs for all requested CPU time.
cases.finding: 普通nice范围是-20至19；PRI和NI是不同列。nice影响普通调度的相对权重，不保证低数值任务拿走全部所需CPU，也不能替代调度类与权限检查。
cases.video_observation: htop visibly has separate PRI and NI columns; selected rows show PRI16 alongside NI-4.
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 画面里的 PRI 和 NI 要分开看。nice 的常见范围是负二十到十九；调低 nice 值，通常提高相对调度权重，并不等于拿到无限 CPU。
cases.production_action: No automatic renice, scheduler or permission changes; original two numeric examples remain distinguishable.

cases.source_claim: OOM kills low-score unimportant processes first; writing positive10 to oom_adj raises sshd's score to1059 and protects it.
cases.finding: 评分方向说反了：在可选择候选中，较高badness通常更易被选中；正调整增加风险，负调整降低。评分不是业务重要性，内存压力也可能在OOM之前出现。
cases.video_observation: The frame visibly shows PID2044, oom_score0, echo10 into legacy oom_adj, then oom_score1059.1059 is not silently changed to fit a generic manual range.
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 这里的 OOM 评分方向说反了：通常分数越高，进程越容易被选中。画面中的正值调整，提高的是被终止的风险，不是在保护 SSH 服务。不要照抄这个演示来保护关键进程；调整评分也不能修复内存泄漏。
cases.production_action: Hard hold: no production narration or deliverable until explicit local correction is timed and approved. Faithful quoted draft is not advice. No /proc writes, kill or SSH/NFS policy changes were performed.

cases.source_claim: New free includes all shared, buffers and cache memory in the free column.
cases.finding: free与available不是同一列：前者对应未用内存，后者估算无需换页可供新应用使用的内存。并非所有shared或cache都可立即回收。
cases.video_observation: The line-wrapped free output separately shows free2434492 and available3122588; retain wrapping context, not a fabricated single-column sum.
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 这里需要区分 free 和 available。不能把缓存和共享内存一概加进 free；判断还能运行多少新负载，通常还要看可回收性和 available 的估算。
cases.production_action: Keep exact visible field names; do not synthesize the original explanation as an unqualified current free definition.

cases.source_claim: Anonymous memory is associated with a specific process and is not eligible to be swapped.
cases.finding: 匿名页没有对应文件后备，通常可写入交换空间；不可换出需要额外条件，不能从匿名这一属性推出。
cases.ai_correction_candidate: 匿名内存并不是“不能换出的内存”。它通常可以写入交换空间；是否可换出，还要看锁定等具体条件。
cases.production_action: Keep anonymous versus file-backed distinction explicit, not an invented process-private/no-swap equivalence.
